raw_output:
Giver: Right, let's start at the cross marked START. From there, go towards the sandy shore, but keep moving slightly up and left until you hit the well.
Follower: Okay, starting. Towards the shore... wait, the shore is right there on the left. Do I pass it?
Giver: No, don't pass it. Go just past the shore, keep the shore on your left side, and head straight for the well.
Follower: Got it. Left side is the shore. I'm heading for the well.
Giver: Good. Once you're at the well, turn right and head towards the local residents.
Follower: Turning right. Wait, I see a crane bay coming up on the left before I get to the residents. Did you go past the crane bay?
Giver: Yes, the route goes right next to the crane bay. You pass it on your left. Keep going straight past it to the residents.
Follower: Ah, okay. I'm passing the crane bay now. Okay, I'm at the residents now. Turn left?
Giver: No, turn right. From the residents, head towards the wood.
Follower: Wait, the wood is way off to the right. Are you going there?
Giver: No, I meant the woodland. Look for the woodland near the wood. Go there.
Follower: Okay, found the woodland. I'm heading there. Oh no, there's an iron bridge near the wood. Did you go near that?
Giver: No, ignore the iron bridge. Just head to the woodland. Once you're there, turn left towards the hills.
Follower: Okay, passed the iron bridge. Heading to the hills now.
Giver: Right. From the hills, you need to go down towards the dead tree.
Follower: Okay, heading down. Wait, there's a forked stream on the right. Do I cross it?
Giver: No, keep the stream on your right. Go straight past it towards the dead tree.
Follower: Okay, keeping the stream on the right. I see the dead tree. Okay, I'm at the tree. Now what?
Giver: From the tree, head back up towards the farmed land.
Follower: Back up? There's a lagoon on the right. Do I go near the lagoon?
Giver: Yes, head for the lagoon on the right. Stop when you're close to it.
Follower: Okay, heading for the lagoon. Wait, the lagoon is quite far. Okay, I'm near it now. Turn left?
Giver: No, turn left towards the rockfall.
Follower: Okay, turning left towards the rockfall. Oh, the rockfall is on the left, but then I see the pirate ship. Do I go there?
Giver: No, keep going left towards the green bay first, then the pirate ship is further down. Actually, from the lagoon, head left to the rockfall, then up towards the green bay.
Follower: Okay, rockfall on the left. Green bay is further up. Heading there now.
Giver: Yes, heading to the green bay. Once you're there, turn right towards the pine grove.
Follower: Okay, at the green bay. Heading right to the pine grove. Wait, the pine grove is way over there.
Giver: Yes, go all the way to the pine grove.
Follower: Okay, I'm at the pine grove now. Turn left?
Giver: Yes, turn left and head towards the farmed land.
Follower: Okay, heading for the farmed land. Wait, there's another farmed land further east. Which one?
Giver: The one to the west. The one closer to the start. Head to that one.
Follower: Okay, heading to the western farmed land. I'm getting close. Turn right?
Giver: Yes, turn right and head towards the FINISH.
Follower: Okay, turning right. Wait, I don't see a FINISH. Is it the farmed land?
Giver: No, the FINISH is near the pirate ship, but on the left side of the map. It's marked with a cross. Look for the cross.
Follower: Oh! There it is. The pirate ship is on the left, and the cross is near it. Okay, I see the cross.
Giver: Good. Draw the line to the cross.
Follower: Drawing the line... Okay, done.
Giver: Did you reach the cross?
Follower: Yes, I'm at the cross.
Giver: Great. That's it.
Follower: Done!
